A hub has degree n, a leaf degree two, so edge differences in a two-cycle have magnitude <=n+1 and the normalization range is finite/exhaustive. The five bands y<0,y=0,0<y<d,y=d,y>d yield independent integer intervals conditional on band populations; the multinomial formula counts all labeled leaves with no missing global constraints. The sharp d<=2n-2 and all values 1..2n-2 are witnessed, with unique extreme leaves n-1. Independently enumerated complete bounded domains n=1,2,3 yielding N=9,47,299, sharp d=4 at n=3; the infinite-n claim uses the band proof and cited general period<=2 theorem, not the finite checks.
